items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We rehearsed at 47th and South Parkway in Chicago... Bob Schflett at trumpet and Jimmy Bertrame, the drums... Eddie came back and rehearsed with us

ctx.x: With [Unintelligible} band, with Louis Armstrong in there and Eddie South and Jimmy Bertrame, all [unintelligible].
Now is that the biggest black theater?
